newsitem.title: CANADA: Indonesia deadline boosts Placer hopes.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia deadline boosts Placer hopes.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said on Monday that a one-month deadline given to Barrick Gold Corp and Bre-X Minerals Ltd by the Indonesian government boosted Placer's hopes that open bidding would be allowed for Bre-X.

A letter sent by the government to Barrick and Bre-X on Friday gave them one month to settle with their local partners on Bre-X's rich Busang gold discovery in Indonesia. If they did not meet the deadline, all discussions between them and the government would be canceled and the government would have the right to manage Busang II and III.
